info.title: Secrets Manager
info.description: Compliance-first internal secrets manager with zero-knowledge encryption

post.description:
Register a new user and organization.

Creates:
- New organization
- Admin user with owner role
- Default roles (owner, admin, member)

Authenticate user with email and password.

Returns JWT tokens if successful.
If MFA is enabled, returns mfa_required=true.

Verify TOTP code after login.

Requires the temporary token from login response.

Setup MFA for current user.

Returns QR code URL for authenticator app.
Refresh access token using refresh token.

get.description: Get current authenticated user profile.

post.description:
Change user password.

Client must re-encrypt vault keys with new master key and send them.

get.description:
List all vaults accessible to current user.

Includes:
- Personal vaults (owner_type='user', owner_id=user.id)
- Team vaults (where user is a member)

schema.title: Response List Vaults Api V1 Vaults Get

get.description: Get vault details by ID.

delete.description: Delete a vault and all its items.

get.description: List items in a vault with optional filtering.

schema.title: Response List Vault Items Api V1 Vaults  Vault Id  Items Get

post.description: Create a new item in a vault.

get.description:
Get a vault item by ID.

This action is logged for audit. Justification is recommended.

patch.description: Update a vault item. Creates a new version for audit trail.

get.description:
List approval requests pending review.

By default, shows pending approvals for the current user to review.
Admins can see all pending approvals in their organization.

schema.title: Response List Pending Approvals Api V1 Approvals Get

post.description:
Create a new approval request.

Used for sensitive operations like:
- reveal_secret (break-glass)
- share_external
- mass_reset
- delete_vault

get.description: List approval requests created by current user.

schema.title: Response List My Requests Api V1 Approvals My Requests Get

get.description: Get approval request details.

post.description:
Approve an approval request.

Requires appropriate permissions. Cannot approve own requests.

Deny an approval request.

Immediately closes the request as denied.

get.description:
List audit logs with filtering.

Requires admin permissions to view organization-wide logs.

Export audit logs for compliance reporting.

Supports JSON and CSV formats.
List all available audit action types.
Get all available credential categories.

schema.title: Response List Categories Api V1 Credentials Categories Get

get.description: Get current user's role and category permissions.

List credentials based on user permissions:
- Admins see all credentials
- Users see their own + credentials in assigned categories

post.description: Create a new credential. Any authenticated user can create credentials.

get.description: Get a specific credential by ID. Checks permissions.

patch.description: Update a credential. Only admin or creator can update.

delete.description: Delete a credential. Only admin or creator can delete.

get.description: List all user roles. Admin only.

schema.title: Response List User Roles Api V1 Credentials Admin Roles Get

get.description: List all category permissions. Admin only.

schema.title: Response List Category Permissions Api V1 Credentials Admin Category Permissions Get

post.description: Grant category permission to user. Admin only.

get.description: List all users in the organization. Admin only.

post.description: Create a new user. Admin only.

get.description: Get a specific user. Admin only.

delete.description: Deactivate a user (soft delete). Admin only.

post.description: Reset a user's password. Admin only.
